ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Console login password (fallback, min 12 chars). You can change it later from the console itself (PROFILE).

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs sessions and hashes API keys (min 24 chars). Generate: openssl rand -hex 32. Do NOT rotate casually — it invalidates all sessions and key recovery.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: OPTIONAL — GitHub OAuth app client id for console login (create one at github.com/settings/developers, callback = your worker URL + /v1/auth/github/callback). Leave empty to use password login only.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OPTIONAL — the matching GitHub OAuth app secret. Leave empty if you did not create an OAuth app.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS IAM access key id for user 'rodex-gateway' (least-privilege policy in docs/aws-setup.md). REQUIRED — the whole platform runs on DynamoDB.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: The matching AWS secret access key. Keep it safe — it can read/write all your app data.
